home.aboutP1: Indeed, we specialize in the installation, storage, and management of signage materials for real estate brokers for nearly 15 years. We offer reliable and fast service throughout the Greater Montreal region and surrounding areas to clients who seek to optimize their time and who value quality service. Whether you are a real estate broker, developer, event organizer, or other professional, we have solutions to simplify your signage management and allow you to focus on what truly matters: managing your projects.
home.aboutP2: By opening an account with Pancarte Express, you'll have access to all our installation, storage, and management services for your signs, panels, signage, mailboxes, flags, posts, anchors, large commercial structures, temporary displays, and balcony and wall installations, plus many other solutions. You'll also benefit from customized offers for your sector and flexible installation options tailored to your needs. We are proud to have earned the trust of over 300 clients and we are committed to maintaining this relationship through our professionalism and dedication to quality.

residential.title: Residential services
residential.Paragraph1: For quick display of your listing, use our residential installation service.
residential.Paragraph2: Installation or removal of signs, add-ons, key boxes, or any other accessories.

cards.title: Ground Installation
cards.description: The sign is anchored in the ground with a metal anchor to ensure its stability and durability.

cards.title: Illuminated Sign Installation
cards.description: The illuminated sign is anchored in the ground with a metal anchor to ensure its stability and durability. A power cable is then connected to an outdoor electrical outlet, allowing the sign to illuminate and be visible day and night.

cards.title: Ramp Installation
cards.description: The sign is mounted directly to the ramp using a post and metal fasteners to ensure its stability.

cards.title: Balcony Installation
cards.description: The sign is attached directly to the balustrade, front-facing or angled (V-shaped), using plastic cable ties to ensure both visibility and stability. Installation can be performed using a ladder up to a maximum height of approximately 20 feet (second floor approximately) or by appointment with the occupant.

cards.title: Residential Wall Installation
cards.description: The sign is screwed into the wall, or into the brick joint depending on the wall's condition, to ensure durability. Installation can be performed using a ladder up to a maximum height of approximately 20 feet (second floor approximately).

cards.title: Key Box Installation or Removal (Lock Box)
cards.description: Installation of a code lock with a key storage compartment, typically mounted on the front door or according to your specifications.

cards.title: Add-on Installation or Removal
cards.description: Installation of add-ons of your choice on a sign to add information (examples: 'sold', 'for rent', custom add-ons with your branding, etc.). Add-on rental is also available.

cards.title: Open House Arrow Installation
cards.description: Installation of open house arrows (up to 5) pointing to the featured property, placed at busy street corners or specific locations defined by you in the form, with automatic removal at the beginning of the following week.

cards.title: Flag Installation
cards.description: Installation of flags in front of the property to announce an open house or other information.

becomeMember.title: Account Opening
becomeMember.subTitle: Becoming a member at PANCARTE EXPRESS means enjoying numerous benefits
becomeMember.warehouseDesc: Storage, maintenance and management of your inventory. You receive an alert when your inventory is low or signs are damaged, as well as a promotional code with our partner Tout Pour Le Courtier to get discounts on your signage material orders.
becomeMember.placementDesc: In addition to this rate, you benefit from a geographic territory that is yours exclusively, and within which prices are even more advantageous! (contact us for more information)
becomeMember.urgencyDesc: An emergency service to get installations the same day
becomeMember.andMoreDesc1: A correction list at a special rate can be requested twice a year to ensure all your installations are straight and secure
becomeMember.andMoreDesc2: Confirmation photos are sent for each installation, as well as an order history and a monthly invoice grouping all requests
becomeMember.groupAlone: Are you part of a broker group?
becomeMember.group: Yes, I am part of a broker team
becomeMember.alone: No, I am not part of a team
becomeMember.pickupMaterial: Should we pick up your material?
becomeMember.noPickup: No, the material will be stored at the warehouse
